headlines.title: FBI investigating potential breach of its crime database
headlines.description: The FBI is investigating an apparent breach of its National Crime Information Center, two people briefed on the matter told NBC News Friday.

headlines.title: Trump touts historic summit with Xi, Putin
headlines.description: President Trump touted his unprecedented trilateral summit with China’s President Xi and Russian President Putin in a marathon press conference. NBC News’ Monica Alba reports.

headlines.title: Trump, Dana White honor Marine Corps band with $500,000
headlines.description: President Trump and UFC chief Dana white honored the U.S. Marine Corps band with a check of $500,000. This comes after the band received its first-ever Grammy nomination in the Best Orchestral Performance category.

headlines.title: Former Energy Secretary Granholm: Schumer or Van Hollen, Senate Democrats must ‘deliver’
headlines.description: Former Energy Secretary Jennifer Granholm joins Meet the Press Now to discuss the Democrats’ agenda in the Congress after they took control of both chambers in the midterm elections, and permitting reform legislation before the House.

headlines.title: How the White House Correspondents’ Association dinner chaos unfolded
headlines.description: Secret Service faced challenges evacuating President, Vice President, Cabinet officials and Congressional leaders after gunman rushes D.C. gala.

headlines.title: Trump formally ends minting of the penny after nearly 250 years of production
headlines.description: The U.S. Mint, which began producing the currency in 1793, has said it costs nearly 4 cents to make each penny.

headlines.title: Iraqi security forces deploy in Iran-backed militia stronghold
headlines.description: JURF AL-SAKHAR, Iraq — Iraqi security forces deployed in Jurf al-Sakhar, a stronghold of the Kataib Hezbollah armed group, on Friday under a deal that seeks to limit the reach of Iran’s most powerful Shi’ite militia ally in the country without provoking a confrontation.

headlines.title: The GOP’s 2028 hopefuls navigate their party’s midterm wipeout: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Zohran Mamdani tears Achilles while playing soccer against NYC press corps
headlines.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani will be hobbling in a walking boot for at least the next six weeks, saying he forgot that he’s on the doorstep of middle age and tore his Achilles while playing soccer.

headlines.title: White House national cyber director is leaving the administration after series of tech outages
headlines.description: Sean Cairncross has played a key role in crafting AI policy for the Trump administration. His immediate replacement is Kirsten A. Davies.

headlines.title: Senate passes bill simplifying permitting rules to build in America, sending it to House
headlines.description: The Senate voted 62-33 on Thursday night to pass a sweeping bill to simplify and overhaul permitting rules for energy and infrastructure projects.

headlines.title: Justice Department seeks dismissal of its lawsuit in Alaska Senate race
headlines.description: The Trump administration had sought to block certification of the election results if Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan lost. Democrat Mary Peltola won the race.
